svg.title: CloudOps Asset Manager – AWS Architecture
svg.desc: Serverless AWS CRUD architecture using official AWS architecture service icons for CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, IAM, and CloudWatch.
svg.text: Implemented serverless CRUD path with optional production frontend hosting

g.text: Defines API Gateway, Lambda and DynamoDB

svg.text: Implemented core: Browser → API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB, with IAM and CloudWatch. CloudFront/S3 are optional frontend hosting.
